financial institutions are using the persuasive discourse of advertising to promote consumption.

the advertisements of financial institutes are environmentally damaging because the advertisements persuade consumers to consume and the consumption of the products and services advertised is damaging to the environment.
the advertisements of financial institution are environmentally damaging.

the persuasive discourse of the financial institutions.
the way in which financial institutions persuade people to consume.
the persuasive discourse of advertisements for financial institutions and the way in which they persuade people to consume and consume more.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the persuasive discourse of advertising is not limited to the promotion of a particular product, it can be used to persuade people to consume in general.
the advertisements of financial services companies are persuasive and environmentally damaging because they are designed to encourage people to consume and to consume more.
financial institutions are not only contributing to the problem of environmental degradation, but are also actively promoting the consumer culture that is at the heart of the problem.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
financial institutions use persuasive discourses to encourage consumers to consume.

the persuasive discourses within financial institutions are environmentally damaging and that these discourses are not being exposed to the public, and therefore the public are not aware of their damaging nature.

we found that there are many ways in which financial institutions use persuasive discourse to encourage people to consume, but that there is little evidence that this consumption is environmentally damaging.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the discourse used by financial institutions is persuasive and that it is used to promote consumerism.
the discourse of the financial institutions is persuasive and is designed to encourage people to spend money, to consume, and ultimately to damage the environment.

, despite the fact that the financial sector has a responsibility to the environment, their advertisements still promote the same environmentally damaging consumerism that the rest of society is subjected to.
